title: How to download and save your goodies on a computer
notes: Real screens from the website with a synthetic customer (Sam Taylor), a synthetic order (NLC-10001) and a sample PDF. Save locations follow Google Chrome Help and are worded as 'most browsers' because people can change them.

scenes.title: How to download and save your goodies
scenes.subtitle: On a computer
say: Hi there!
In this video, I'll show you how to download your goodies on a computer, save them somewhere easy to find, and find them again later.

scenes.title: Sign in to your account
lines: Click the person icon at the top right of any page.
say: First, let's sign in.
Click the person icon at the top right of any page.

scenes.title: Sign in to your account
lines: Enter your email and password.
Then click Sign in.
say: Enter the email and password for your account.
Then click Sign in.

scenes.title: Open My downloads
lines: Your account opens.
Click the My downloads tab.
say: Your account opens.
Click the My downloads tab.

scenes.title: Find your resource
lines: Each purchase has its own card, with the order number and version.
Ready to save? It says 1 download available.
say: Each purchase has its own card, with the order number and the version.
When it's ready, it says one download available.

scenes.title: Before you download
lines: Each digital purchase includes one download of the latest version.
Starting the download uses it. Just viewing the page does not.
When a new version is released, you get one new download of it.
say: Before you download, here's the important part.
Each digital purchase includes one download of the latest version.
Starting the download uses it. Just looking at this page doesn't.
And when a new version comes out, you'll get one new download of it.

scenes.title: Start your download
lines: When you're ready, click Download on the card.
say: When you're ready to save it, click Download on the card.

scenes.title: Start your download
lines: A reminder appears.
Read it, then click Download now.
say: A reminder pops up.
Read it, then click Download now.

scenes.title: Save the file
lines: A message says your download has started.
Your browser saves the file to your computer.
say: A message lets you know your download has started.
From here, your browser saves the file to your computer.

scenes.title: Where your file goes
lines: Most browsers save files to your Downloads folder.
If your browser asks where to save it, pick a folder you'll remember.
Tip: keep your inserts together in one folder, like one named Nurse Love.
say: Most browsers save files to your Downloads folder.
If your browser asks where to save it, pick a folder you'll remember.
Tip: keep all your inserts together in one folder, like one named Nurse Love.

scenes.title: Find it again

devices.label: Windows
lines: Open File Explorer.
Click Downloads, or the folder you chose.

devices.label: Mac
lines: Open Finder.
Click Downloads in the sidebar, or the folder you chose.

say: To find it again on Windows, open File Explorer, then click Downloads, or the folder you chose.
On a Mac, open Finder, then click Downloads in the sidebar.

scenes.title: Check your file
lines: My downloads now shows Download used and the date.
The website can't see your computer, so it can't tell if the file saved.
Open the file once to make sure it's there.
say: Back on the website, My downloads now says Download used, with the date.
The website can't see your computer, so it can't tell whether the file saved.
So open the file once, just to make sure it's there.

scenes.title: Need help?
lines: File didn't save or won't open?
Click Report a download problem. A person at the store reads every report.
say: If the file didn't save, or it won't open, click Report a download problem.
A real person at the store reads every report.

scenes.title: Need help?
lines: For anything else, click Support in your account and send a message.
You'll hear back by email.
say: For anything else, click Support in your account and send a message.
You'll hear back by email.

scenes.title: You're all set
scenes.subtitle: Download once, save it somewhere easy to find, and open it to check.
say: And that's it!
Download once, save it somewhere easy to find, and open it to check.
Thanks for watching.
